directions.name: Finders Keepers
pitch: Every lost ball, glove and playground oddment lands in a desert beyond the fence.
Pick sides, play for keeps, and hang out on the same battered court between fights.
directions.world: A world of lost playground equipment over the fence: pale chalk court on torn tarmac mesa above a dusty violet desert, enormous faint schoolyard moon, chain-link fence and bucket-built sandcastles. Palette warm parchment, dusty lavender, muted sage, charcoal. Heroes are the objects themselves with tiny simple limbs, not humans holding equipment: Fletcher a tall cylindrical cream quiver with three arrows and a small bent bow, Mitts a squat oversized worn taupe catcher's glove whose fingers form the head, Carom an angular cream squash racket with tiny limbs and open oval mesh head. Neutral materials with team bibs only.
directions.arena: A torn tarmac slab in desert air, chalk two lanes around sandbucket cover, bucket-sandcastle towers at ends, central gold ball pickup.
directions.lobby: A lived-in patch of court beyond a bent fence. A low cupboard contains hero props, a marble table and hopping chalk squares invite idle play, three empty blue team seats and three red seats sit beside the launch gate, passing small lost objects NPCs. A tiny glove player can walk between all stations. The readiness gate leads physically onto the court.

directions.name: Low Tide
directions.tag: Harbour crews settle it on the slipway
pitch: The tide goes out; rival dock crews take over the slipway for a quick scrap.
Throw, hook and ricochet through a harbour that works as your lobby as well as your arena.
directions.world: A working fishing harbour, no pirates or tropical resort. Very chunky human dockworkers, rain capes, rubber boots, buoys, coiled rope, fish crates. Palette bone concrete, dark desaturated sea-green, fog-grey, charcoal, muted peach. Three heroes: a short broad woman dockhand in sage waterproof apron carrying an enormous cream oval lifebuoy for catches, a tall lean fisherman in charcoal sou'wester with curved pole and rope hook, a square-bodied deck mechanic in peach dungarees carrying a long flat boat paddle for ricochets. Huge readable headgear and equipment; faceted simple faces; team sash colour only.
directions.arena: A pale drained concrete slipway surrounded by dark green water and moored little geometric boats at the perimeter, two lanes around low rope-crate walls, capstan towers and buoy-cage cores, central gold buoy projectile pickup.
directions.lobby: An open little quayside harbour square connected to the slipway. Walk past a gear rack to select heroes, toss practice floats into water targets, choose crew by sitting on three crates, then stand on a painted departure gangway to ready up. A fisherman NPC mends rope; a little ferry idles at the edge. All floor stations have clear traversable paths.

directions.name: Uproar
directions.tag: The show is a three-on-three fight
pitch: Three actors a side, one stage, and absolutely no agreement about who gets the spotlight.
Masks, props and trapdoors turn a theatre into a brawler; backstage is where you pick your part.
directions.world: A mischievous tiny touring theatre world made of painted plywood, cardboard flats and chunky simple masks. Not medieval fantasy or ornate circus. Palette pale mint painted floor, dark aubergine curtains, dusty mauve and chalk cream, ink black. Three heroes: a slim triangular masked acrobat in a plain diamond-pattern neutral unitard wielding two flat fan blades; a squat pear-shaped stagehand with oversized round cream comedy mask and padded cylinder mallet; a tall rectangular diva shaped like a folded paper costume with an oval half-black half-cream face mask carrying a megaphone. Team ribbons detachable. Faces are graphic mask shapes, geometry cheap.
directions.arena: An overhead pale mint rectangular thrust stage within a dark theatre, two clear lanes around low hinged plywood scenery flats, spotlight-can towers, simple mask emblem cores. Discrete cone and circle telegraphs and central gold spotlight token. Curtains and audience dots only outside the playfield.
directions.lobby: A walkable open backstage rehearsal stage with wings, prop rack hero selection, mirrors as character preview, practice dummy, three folding ready chairs and a large curtain portal into the arena. Stagehand NPC wheels a tiny scenery flat outside the main paths. One actor player walks the floor. In-world signs extremely sparse.

Quiet light floor, darker desaturated surround; red and cobalt blue reserved for team bibs/foot discs and combat markers, gold only for the contested projectile. Dot eyes restrained, detachable team paperclip bibs. A photocopier and huge swivel chair provide scale at edges.

Exactly SIX small heroes, three blue and three red, one instance of each of the three described types per team, spread in a real readable skirmish; tiny minion squads, readable overhead segmented HP bars, foot discs and two thin simple ground telegraphs, one gold projectile. Characters should be SMALL versus floor, arena traversable and uncluttered; landscape surround quiet. HUD: compact cream thick-ink score/timer strip top centre, small minimap upper right, portrait frame upper left, three simple Q W E buttons bottom centre. No giant title. It must plausibly look like a flat-colour Three.js game actually being played.
Specific environment: A pale paper desk blotter arena atop two joined office desks, quiet faint filing grid, two lanes around low eraser and paper-stack cover, pencil-pot towers and hole-punch cores. Giant drawers and dark office floor outside, central gold brass paperclip projectile.
